copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often publish knowledge-based visual content on Xiaohongshu

howto.what: Claude 会把你的内容排成多张 1080×1440 竖版卡片,纵向连排,方便整体或单张截图。第一张是封面(大标题+一行副标题+标签),中间每张一个核心观点,最后一张总结加行动号召。
howto.when: 当你要把内容做成小红书风格的图文卡片、多张联排可滑动浏览时触发。卡片张数按内容信息量定,短内容 3-6 张起步,长内容更多。

howto.what_en: Claude lays your content out as multiple 1080×1440 vertical cards stacked in one column, easy to screenshot as a whole or one by one. The first card is a cover with a big title, one subtitle line and a tag; each middle card holds one core point; the last sums up with a call to action.
howto.when_en: Use when you want content turned into Xiaohongshu-style image cards or a swipeable multi-card set. Card count follows content volume: 3-6 for short content, more for long.
